correctness.rationale: For q=(u+v)/2 the diagonal-inclusive Sidon condition leaves only the diagonal term or the conjugate pair belonging to one unordered off-diagonal pair. The diagonal contribution to the unweighted absolute sum is 1; each nonzero u-v yields each character value N/p times. Modulo pi, multiplication by 2 permutes the p equally spaced arguments. At phase displacement at most pi/(2p) the absolute cosines have fixed signs in the interior (with zeros allowed at the endpoints); reflection cancels the sine terms, and the centered Dirichlet sum is csc(pi/(2p)). The deficit then follows from sum_{u<v}(b_u-b_v)^2=(m-1)-2 sum_{u<v} b_u b_v. Positivity on the exact support makes vanishing equivalent to equal moduli and all phases in a common grid coset; m=1 is automatic. A sum and sum of squares determine the monic quadratic with the two graph parameters as roots, including the repeated-root case. Character orthogonality gives sum |W|^2=1/N, so Cauchy–Schwarz over N^2 sites gives the stated universal benchmark. RESULT.md lines 42–72 establish the unrestricted quantifiers within this support class. The recorded check_wigner_sidon.py tests four finite supports against direct summation and was inspected, not rerun.
